term_months.notes: The plan length is chosen by the customer within printed bands: '2-3 שנים' ('לא כולל תקופה של 3 שנים') and '3-4 שנים' ('לא כולל תקופה של 4 שנים'); a 36-month plan falls in the '3-4 שנים' row (PeriodLengthInDays 1096). Both rows print the same rate.

rate_offered.notes: Printed 1.25 (fixed, 'לא צמוד', 'ללא תחנות יציאה') for 'חיסכון ליעד ארוך' rows '2-3 שנים' and '3-4 שנים'; the page lists it under 'פיקדון בהוראת קבע' (standing order). tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08).

break.mechanism_text: 'קיימת עם קנס שבירה'. The page's clarification: the bank may allow a break at its discretion; the penalty is computed on the remaining period to the next exit point or maturity from the bank's daily 'טבלת ריבית לווים', is never less than the deposit rate plus a 'מרווח שבירה' set by the bank, may cut into principal ('ואף תיתכן פגיעה בקרן הפיקדון'); a deposit of a year or more cannot be broken partially in its first year and a liquidity cost is added. Not computable from the publication.
